name: NEOCHAT - Cyberpunk Anonymous Chat
description: Cyberpunk anonymous encrypted chat with WiFi scanner, GPS maps of Portugal, and mesh networking based on MeshCore protocol.

deployment.instructions: 1. Start backend: node server.js (or PORT=3000 node server.js). 2. Frontend is served from /api/status and / on the same server. 3. For itch.io: Upload public/ contents as HTML5 build, configure CHAT_SERVER_URL in index.html to point to backend.
